interface.signature: def work_on_strings(a: str, b: str) -> str:

preconditions.description: Both inputs `a` and `b` are non-empty strings.

postconditions.expression: all(c.islower() if c.isupper() else c.isupper() for c in a if c.lower() in (ch.lower() for ch in b)) and all(c.islower() if c.isupper() else c.isupper() for c in b if c.lower() in (ch.lower() for ch in a))
postconditions.description: For every character `c` in the output string, if `c` (case-insensitive) exists in the other input string, its case is swapped exactly once for each occurrence of its case-insensitive version in the other input string. The output is the modified `a` followed by the modified `b`.
The output string has the same length as the concatenation of the original `a` and `b`.

postconditions.expression: return_value[:len(a)] == ''.join([c.swapcase() if c.lower() in (ch.lower() for ch in b) else c for c in a]) and return_value[len(a):] == ''.join([c.swapcase() if c.lower() in (ch.lower() for ch in a) else c for c in b])
postconditions.description: The first part of the output (length of `a`) is `a` with each character's case swapped for every occurrence of its case-insensitive version in `b`. The second part (length of `b`) is `b` with each character's case swapped for every occurrence of its case-insensitive version in `a`.
